name: Zuranolone
summary: Zuranolone, sold under the brand name Zurzuvae, is a medication used for the treatment of postpartum depression and major depressive disorder. It is taken orally. Zuranolone is a neuroactive steroid which enhances the activity of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) and is thought to exert antidepressant effects by enhancing GABAergic inhibition.

pharmacology.text: Zuranolone is a neuroactive steroid which enhances the activity of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) and is thought to exert antidepressant effects by enhancing GABAergic inhibition.
pharmacology.kind: Neurosteroid; GABAA receptor positive allosteric modulator

uses.text: Zuranolone is indicated for the treatment of postpartum depression in the United States and for the treatment of major depressive disorder in Japan. It was not approved for major depressive disorder in the United States.

sideEffects.text: The most common side effects include drowsiness, dizziness, diarrhea, fatigue, nasopharyngitis, and urinary tract infection.
